verification_report.summary:
Every assertion and deduction in the supplied supplement passes under the explicitly accepted manuscript prerequisites. The audit records 22 sequential statement checks and five reference checks, with no critical errors or gaps. The book was not edited.

For general smooth real nef backgrounds, including nonclosed ones, pseudoeffectivity and monotonicity give positive finite constants c,C with c epsilon^n <= V_mu(theta+epsilon h) <= C. Division by log epsilon < 0 correctly reverses the inequalities, proving 0 <= lower order <= upper order <= n and boundedness of the logarithmic quotients. Fixed smooth positive densities have uniform comparison constants, so their logarithmic errors vanish after division by log epsilon. Hermitian metric comparison, the reversed squeeze, and rescaling epsilon by any fixed positive constant preserve each of liminf and limsup separately. Gauge changes preserve nefness and the perturbed volumes; positive scaling gives exactly the stated degree-n formula. Positive boundary volume implies zero orders by nef continuity. Neither the converse nor equality of the two orders is inferred.

In the closed nef Kahler case, smooth strictly positive representatives exist for every theta+delta h. Their mixed integrals are positive and agree with the cohomological integrals by closed Stokes; taking delta to zero proves all coefficients are nonnegative without requiring convergence of the potentials. The k=0 coefficient is positive, so r exists. The accepted volume identity gives the displayed polynomial, whose first nonzero term is binomial(n,r) times the positive r-th intersection times epsilon^(n-r). This proves the order n-r and matches the usual intersection definition of numerical dimension. Both endpoints r=0 and r=n are valid. In dimension one, V_mu(theta+epsilon h)=integral theta+epsilon integral h, giving order one when integral theta=0 and order zero otherwise.

On the Hopf threefold, alpha is nef because alpha+epsilon omega is already positive. The identities alpha^3=beta^2=0 give Omega_epsilon^3=epsilon(1+epsilon)^2 omega^3, with the exact coefficient 6 relative to the probability measure mu_0. The zero potential solves the normalized smooth equation, so the accepted positive-cone formula yields V_mu_0=6 epsilon(1+epsilon)^2 and both orders equal one. The first proposition transfers these orders to every fixed allowed density and Hermitian direction. For every fixed epsilon>0, the smooth potentials epsilon V_j are admissible and their forms dominate epsilon(omega+ddc V_j). Determinant monotonicity therefore proves divergent masses and v_+=infinity. This does not identify upper mass with fixed-density variational volume or assume the bounded mass property.

All internal references match the accepted definitions, hypotheses and normalizations; no new external-paper reference requires theorem search. The final questions remain unresolved in the supplement. Concavity alone does not justify general exponent existence, integrality, or a modification law, and none is claimed.
